notes: The shell is denied outright while pending: the model reliably falls back to redirection when the editor tools are blocked, so gating only Write and Edit would leave the hole open. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
